ul.li: Enable caching to speed up repeated translations and reduce API costs.
Set a size limit based on the available disk space and expected translation volume.
Balance the expiration time between freshness and reuse (7-15 days is recommended).
Choose the Primary model based on your translation quality requirements and cost considerations.
Use quality check for complex documents that require a high level of accuracy.
Configure a set of Retry models to use as fallback options.

section.title: Retry Strategy

ul.li: A setting of 3 max retries is usually sufficient for most scenarios.
For the model sequence, start with cost-effective models and then move to premium models for retries.

section.p: This configuration system provides flexibility to optimize translation quality, performance, and cost based on your specific requirements and available AI models.
